title: Into water
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：into　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 into 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the shopkeeper kept the scale ① into the night at the counter, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the scale had been left ② into the cold water, and nobody had asked a single question. The shopkeeper had come to the shop two months earlier and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The account for July 1980 puts it plainer. It was done ③ into a shape nobody knew, and the buyer who kept the scale had counted it ④ into the hands of the doctor twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done into a shape nobody knew in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ into the need of the hour, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ into the care of the old nurse; he was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was that the scale be counted ⑦ into the form of a boat, and that the names be written ⑧ into the story of the village. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried into the form of a boat.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996 she kept the scale ⑨ into the night again when nobody else would, and ⑩ into the cold water, she said in 1998, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the scale in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot what had been done into the cold water.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 进入（表时间：into the night）
B. prep. 进入（表处所：into the cold water）
C. prep. 成为（表方式／状态：into a shape nobody knew）
D. prep. 成为（引出施动者或相关的人：be counted into the hands of the doctor）
E. prep. 进入（表原因：into the need of the hour）
F. prep. 成为（表对象／目的：into the care of the old nurse）
G. prep. 进入（表工具／材料：into the form of a boat）
H. prep. 成为（表载体／处所：written into the story of the village）

items.q: into the hands of the doctor
into the need of the hour
into the care of the old nurse
into the form of a boat
into the story of the village
into the cold water, she said

answers.why: into 意为“进入”，此处引出时间 the night（深夜），说明那件小小的秤是在何时留下的。
into 意为“进入”，此处引出处所 the cold water（冰冷的水里），说明东西被放在何处。
into 意为“成为”，此处引出方式或状态 a shape nobody knew（谁也不认识的模样），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
into 意为“成为”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 大夫的手里：be counted into the hands of the doctor。
into 意为“进入”，此处引出原因 the need of the hour（当下的需要），说明整件事由何而起。
into 意为“成为”，此处引出对象或目的 the care of the old nurse（老护士的照料之下）。
into 意为“进入”，此处引出工具或材料 the form of a boat（一条船的模样）。
into 意为“成为”，此处引出载体 the story of the village（村子的传说里）：names written into the story of the village。
into 意为“进入”，1996 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的秤，此处仍引出时间 the night。
into 意为“进入”，母亲 1998 年那句话引出的仍是那一处冰冷的水里。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年深夜前后，掌柜把那件小小的秤留在了柜台。（into the night）
那件小小的秤被放在冰冷的水里，谁也没有过问。（into the cold water）
整件事是谁也不认识的模样做成的，账本上写得明白。（into a shape nobody knew）
入冬之前，那件小小的秤已经由大夫的手里数过两回。（be counted into the hands of the doctor）
叔叔说，整件事是由当下的需要起的。（into the need of the hour）
他说，家里从来没有人为老护士的照料之下做过这件事。（into the care of the old nurse）
answers: In 1986 the shopkeeper kept the scale into the night at the counter.
The scale had been left into the cold water, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done into a shape nobody knew, or so the account says.
The scale had been counted into the hands of the doctor twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun into the need of the hour.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it into the care of the old nurse.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 into 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the shopkeeper kept the scale into the night, and nobody forgot it.
The scale had been left into the cold water for three months.
The work was done into a shape nobody knew, as it always was in those days.
The scale had been counted into the hands of the doctor twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the scale into the night again when nobody else would.
The whole shop never forgot what had been done into the cold water.
